sanskrit_verse: पुरुषाः सन्ति ये लोभात् प्रब्रूयुः साक्ष्यम् अन्यथा। सन्ति चान्ये दुरात्मानः कूटलेख्यकृतो जनाः॥
transliteration: puruṣāḥ santi ye lobhāt prabrūyuḥ sākṣyam anyathā | santi cānye durātmānaḥ kūṭalekhyakṛto janāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: There exist men who, driven by greed, testify falsely; there are also wicked souls who fabricate forged documents.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from alignment with Sanatana Dharma, not personal motive.
Causation is traced through conscious intent and distortion of truth.
Capacity-based responsibility demands integrity in testimony and documentation.
Restoration logic requires purification of falsehood and realignment of consciousness.
Consciousness alignment is obstructed by greed and deliberate falsification.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a witness alters testimony due to lobha (greed), THEN disqualify that testimony and initiate capacity-restoration protocol.
IF a person creates or presents kūṭa-lekhya (forged document), THEN invalidate all legal effects derived from it and assign completion process for rectification.
IF false evidence influences judicial outcome, THEN reverse procedural actions and realign based on pristine pramāṇa.
IF individual acts from durātman (degraded consciousness), THEN enforce nyāya-based reintegration rather than punitive exclusion.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any testimony or document found influenced by greed or falsification shall be nullified ipso facto. The court must realign proceedings based on uncorrupted pramāṇa and ensure restoration of dharma-vyavasthā without punitive overlays. Responsibility lies in correcting causal distortion, not inflicting consequence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the root distortion introduced by greed or forgery. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces the sequential impact of falsehood upon judicial integrity. Proportional responsibility rests with restoring factual alignment, not punishing the agent. The non-punitive reality rule ensures correction occurs through consciousness purification, not coercive suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sākṣya-shuddhi vidhi (testimony purification process) to restore witness integrity.
Execute lekhyānusandhāna śuddhi (document verification protocol) to isolate and nullify forged instruments.
Assign kartavya-samāpana (duty completion process) to individuals whose actions caused systemic misalignment.
Implement chitta-prasādana (consciousness pacification) measures for durātman agents to restore dharmic orientation.
final_declaration: Thus declared by Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma. Falsehood born of greed disrupts cosmic order; yet Dharma prevails through purification, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. All distortions resolved, Dharma is restored.
